verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an open-source migration tool that bulk-creates users in Clerk from a JSON or CSV file via the Backend API, respecting rate limits. It also names 'Basic Export / Import' and trickle migration as strategies for moving users in from another platform. This covers only the inbound bulk-import half of the story. missing for 10: evidence that password hashes can be imported, any documented way to export users (with hashes) back out of Clerk, independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration tool.
